rows.definition: Coordinates physical blocks and sequence mappings for paged attention KV storage.
rows.distinction: KVPoolConfig specifies dimensions and layout before construction; KVPool owns the mutable mappings and allocator.

rows.definition: Specifies total pages, tokens per page, attention geometry, dtype, and topology for the paged KV pool.
rows.distinction: KVPool is the live pool built from this configuration, not its input specification.

rows.definition: Constructs a paged KV pool from KVPoolConfig, including its physical block allocator.
rows.distinction: KVPool is the resulting live object; NewKVPool is its constructor and can return an error.

rows.definition: Accounts for reserved and committed attention tokens across streams against a shared capacity.
rows.distinction: KVPool maps sequence tokens to physical KV blocks; SharedTokenPool tracks token capacity reservations.

rows.definition: Attempts to release idle backend pools through the planner before an allocation retry.
rows.distinction: KVPool owns physical blocks and mappings; trimBackendIdlePools requests release of idle backend allocations before retry.

rows.definition: Signals that an operation encountered a session branch that has already been released.
rows.distinction: LoadSessionCheckpoint reads persisted agent state; ErrSessionReleased signals that a COW branch is no longer usable.

rows.definition: Reads a session checkpoint from an explicit path or a session ID resolved under the default directory.
rows.distinction: ErrSessionReleased signals a released in-memory COW branch; LoadSessionCheckpoint reads persisted agent checkpoint data.

rows.definition: Opts a planner into soft per-conversation selection of a llama-server slot.
rows.distinction: LlamaSoftSlotPolicy chooses the behavior when a conversation slot is busy; LlamaSoftSlot enables the feature.

rows.definition: Selects the soft-slot choice policy for an opted-in planner; empty uses LRU.
rows.distinction: LlamaSoftSlot enables the mechanism, while this field selects its policy.

rows.definition: Names the soft-slot policy that moves a conversation with a busy slot to a least recently used idle slot.
rows.distinction: SoftSlotPolicyWait can keep a known conversation pinned to its listed busy slot.

rows.definition: Names the soft-slot policy that may pin a known conversation to its listed slot even while busy.
rows.distinction: SoftSlotPolicyLRU instead moves a conversation from its busy slot to an idle least recently used slot.

rows.definition: Adds an id_slot to an eligible opted-in request when soft slot selection succeeds, and returns its lease.
rows.distinction: LlamaSoftSlot is the enable flag; withLlamaSoftSlot carries out request selection and binding.

rows.definition: Reports how many leading input tokens are resident in the planner cache.
rows.distinction: cachePopulate marks execution whose purpose is to populate that cache; cachedPrefixLen reads the resident-prefix length.

rows.definition: Marks an in-kernel execution as cache-population work for the planner.
rows.distinction: cachedPrefixLen probes resident leading tokens; cachePopulate selects the execution purpose.

rows.definition: Identifies the new child branch in a copy-on-write ForkSession call; it must differ from the parent and be unused.
rows.distinction: sessionFromPrefixClone creates a model session around a supplied KV cache; childSessionID identifies a new COW branch.

rows.definition: Holds FIFO reuse order for released blocks whose contents remain cached by the elastic allocator.
rows.distinction: cachedPrefixLen reports a token-prefix length; cachedBlocks is an ordered list of reusable block IDs.

rows.definition: Replays a single expert cache policy over unit-sized groups to produce its result row.
rows.distinction: cachePopulate marks a live in-kernel execution purpose; cachePolicyReplayArm simulates a policy over a supplied access stream.

rows.definition: Stores bounded eviction records pending confirmation on the radix KV tree.
rows.distinction: evictionLedgerCap bounds the ledger; evictLedger stores staged victim records awaiting confirmation.

rows.definition: Bounds the number of pending records retained in the radix-tree eviction ledger.
rows.distinction: evictLedger contains the pending records; evictionLedgerCap bounds that collection.

rows.definition: Creates a model session, using the configured backend when present, and assigns it a supplied prefix KV cache.
rows.distinction: childSessionID identifies a proposed copy-on-write child branch; sessionFromPrefixClone builds a model session around a supplied cache.

rows.definition: Snapshots a session terminal transcript, sorted effects, and recovery dependency under the client runtime lock.
rows.distinction: LoadSessionCheckpoint reads persisted agent checkpoint data; sessionView snapshots gateway client session state.

rows.definition: Constructs the optional remote engine-cache reset client from gateway configuration, validating engine and base URL.
rows.distinction: cachedPrefixLen measures local in-kernel cache residency; newEngineCacheClient constructs a remote cache-reset client.

rows.definition: Removes the final cached prompt token when eligible so an exact cache hit can refeed that token.
rows.distinction: cachedPrefixLen measures resident prefix length; inKernelRefeedLastTokenForExactHit modifies the cache tail for an exact hit.

rows.definition: Marks that a run should merge context_control into its seed tool catalog.
rows.distinction: ContextControlCatalog supplies tool definitions when armed; contextControl is the run configuration switch.

rows.definition: Returns context_control tool definitions when the control is armed, and nil when unarmed.
rows.distinction: contextControl is the run flag that requests catalog inclusion; ContextControlCatalog supplies the definitions.

rows.definition: Carries a stream context-health status, reason, remaining budgets, and reset recommendation.
rows.distinction: EvaluateContextSafety computes this verdict from stream specification and state.

rows.definition: Evaluates stream usage against turn and token limits and returns a context-safety verdict.
rows.distinction: ContextSafetyVerdict is the result data; EvaluateContextSafety performs the assessment.

rows.definition: Creates an option that supplies the context used for structured-compression caller policy resolution.
rows.distinction: contextControl requests an agent tool catalog addition; WithCompressionContext configures a compression operation.

rows.definition: Creates a child session branch sharing its parent pages under copy-on-write management.
rows.distinction: SessionFork in executionroute names a routing action; this operation creates the page-table child branch.

rows.definition: Represents a coordinator or subagent branch with copy-on-write page blocks.
rows.distinction: SessionFork is an execution-route choice; this branch holds the managed page-table state.

rows.definition: Carries requested, emitted, and effective provider-cache hint information on an agent completion.
rows.distinction: CacheHit is a vDSO cache lifecycle event; this receipt describes provider hint negotiation.

rows.definition: Returns a resident expert slot on a hit; otherwise selects an empty or least-recently-used slot and assigns the requested expert ID.
rows.distinction: The llama soft-slot release operation frees a request pin; expert slot acquisition finds or assigns expert residency.

rows.definition: Releases an upstream call's soft llama-server slot pin if one exists; a nil call is safe.
rows.distinction: Expert slot-stream acquisition selects expert residency; this release frees a conversation request pin.

rows.definition: Settles every staged eviction record once, increments confirmed accounting, and clears the ledger.
rows.distinction: The onEvict callback observes an individual policy eviction; confirmation settles a batch of staged radix-tree records.

rows.definition: Receives the key hash and length of an entry evicted by the WTinyLFU policy.
rows.distinction: Radix KV staged eviction confirmation settles recorded radix victims; this callback reports an individual policy eviction.

rows.definition: The gateway wire form of a reset transaction, including old and new trace IDs, seed digest, contributors, omitted spans, and rearmed budget.
rows.distinction: The reset budget rearm is one component of this transaction, not the entire reset record.

rows.definition: Records fresh turn, token, and context budget values armed by a reset.
rows.distinction: The reset transaction encloses this budget alongside trace and seed information.

rows.definition: A payload-free pointer to a source span omitted during reset, carrying role, digest, and reason.
rows.distinction: The reset transaction can carry a list of omitted-span pointers; one pointer is not the whole transaction.

rows.definition: Creates a harness-prefixed random identifier for one launch, returning empty if random generation fails.
rows.distinction: The COW child branch fork operates on session state; this function creates a launch attribution identifier.

rows.definition: Signals that an empty session ID was supplied to the ctxmmu checkpoint manager.
rows.distinction: The COW table invalid-session sentinel belongs to its branch operations; this error belongs to checkpoint operations.

rows.definition: Signals an empty session ID in ctxmmu fork and copy-on-write session operations.
rows.distinction: The checkpoint manager has its own empty-session-ID sentinel; this one belongs to branch operations.

rows.definition: Binds a nonempty tenant and optional agent identity to a planner-call context for scoped prefix caching.
rows.distinction: Provider cache hint receipt describes negotiation; this context binding establishes the local cache owner.

rows.canonical: HTTP planner provider cache telemetry attachment
rows.definition: Adds provider cache telemetry to an eligible completion with reported cached prompt tokens when telemetry is not already present.
rows.distinction: Provider cache hint receipt records hint negotiation; this method attaches observed provider cache telemetry.

rows.canonical: Radix tree retained CPU cache byte count
rows.definition: Walks radix roots to total retained numeric KV payload, logits capacity, and shared dense-prefix bytes.
rows.distinction: The max CPU cache bytes field sets a retention bound; this function calculates retained bytes.

rows.canonical: Radix tree CPU cache retention limit
rows.definition: Stores the byte bound for retained CPU KV backing storage and cached logits; zero leaves retention unlimited.
rows.distinction: The retained-byte count calculates current ownership; this field sets its limit.

rows.canonical: Radix tree CPU cache room admission
rows.definition: Attempts to fit incoming retained payload under the byte bound by releasing eligible old payloads, refusing oversized or pinned cases.
rows.distinction: The retained-byte count measures current storage; this method may release payloads to make room.

rows.canonical: Radix CPU cache saturating byte sum
rows.definition: Adds two byte counts, saturating at the maximum signed 64-bit value for negative inputs or overflow.
rows.distinction: The retained-byte count walks cache nodes; this helper safely combines individual byte counts.

rows.definition: Names the planner-facing context_control tool for bounded context queries and controls.
rows.distinction: ContextControlCatalog supplies tool definitions when armed; ToolContextControl names the tool those definitions expose.

rows.definition: Returns entries from an input allow-list after removing the specified names.
rows.distinction: Guard allow expiry stamping sets or clears time limits on grants; subtraction removes named entries from a list.

rows.definition: Stamps added names with now plus a positive TTL, or clears their expiry stamps for a zero TTL.
rows.distinction: Allow-list subtraction removes named entries; expiry stamping changes their expiry metadata.

rows.definition: Holds the resolved router origin, gateway key, and key-source description for a guard invocation.
rows.distinction: The API host readiness gate summarizes probe classifications; this value identifies a guard upstream and its authentication.

rows.definition: Reports true when at least one target exists and none is invalid or unclassified in the API-host readiness summary.
rows.distinction: Guard router upstream holds connection details; the readiness gate summarizes the probe classification conditions.

rows.definition: Holds subagent sessions currently occupying the scheduler's active concurrency slots.
rows.distinction: Expert slot-stream acquisition selects a device expert buffer; activeSlots tracks scheduled subagent sessions.

rows.definition: Implements preallocated device expert slots for MoE models and streams cold experts into slots on demand.
rows.distinction: Expert slot acquisition is one operation within slotstream; the package owns the slot-pool mechanism.

rows.definition: Names .fak/sessions as the default workspace directory for agent session checkpoints.
rows.distinction: The harness launch session ID identifies a launch; this constant identifies a default checkpoint directory.

rows.definition: Returns the trimmed local hostname for session durability attribution, falling back to localhost when empty.
rows.distinction: The launch session ID is a random launch-scoped identifier; this helper supplies a host label.

rows.definition: Records the effective guard posture name in a native agent enforcement receipt.
rows.distinction: The Codex no-guard flag chooses raw launching; guard posture records an effective enforcement value in a receipt.

rows.definition: Acts as an alias for raw mode and contributes to the Codex launcher's raw selection.
rows.distinction: Guard posture is an enforcement receipt field; no-guard is a launcher flag selecting raw mode.

rows.definition: Carries per-request generated and prompt counts, cache-match information, timings, stop status, and execution receipts from in-kernel generation.
rows.distinction: cachedPrefixLen probes currently resident prefix length; this result records the completed generation request.

rows.definition: Sets the device-memory headroom ratio to 0.15 for in-kernel request admission and related sizing.
rows.distinction: Radix CPU cache retention limit bounds retained host KV and logits; this ratio reserves device-memory headroom for a request.

rows.definition: Resolves an explicit forced tool name or the sole tool when required; otherwise returns an empty name.
rows.distinction: ContextControlCatalog returns the available tool definitions; this helper resolves the tool name required by a request.

rows.definition: Serializes startup claim acquisition, validation, release and expiry reclamation over a shared radix tree.
rows.distinction: KVPool owns physical KV block allocation; StartupCache coordinates startup claims on a radix tree.

rows.definition: Allocates an empty model KV cache with attended K and V rows at the selected precision; unset selects FP32.
rows.distinction: KVPool constructor creates a paged physical-block pool; this constructor creates a model KV cache with a precision choice.

rows.definition: Names the bounded agent cache-control prior used to bias a KV span's estimated reuse in eviction costing.
rows.distinction: Provider cache hint receipt records provider hint negotiation; this hint adjusts a local eviction-cost prior.

rows.definition: Reports whether a source has its mapped page-cache read path enabled.
rows.distinction: StartupCache coordinates radix startup claims; this predicate reports a GGUF expert-source page-cache mode.

rows.definition: Disables in-kernel paged prefix ledger creation for off, 0, false, or no; other values do not trigger that opt-out.
rows.distinction: The radix budget environment setting supplies a token bound; this switch controls paged ledger opt-out.

rows.definition: Supplies a nonnegative integer override for the radix prefix cache token budget when parseable.
rows.distinction: Paged prefix ledger environment switch controls ledger opt-out; this setting supplies the radix token bound.

rows.definition: Provides a parsed integer seed for reproducible in-kernel sampling when set to a valid value.
rows.distinction: The radix budget environment setting bounds cache tokens; this value seeds sampling.

rows.canonical: GGUF expert page-cache opt-in environment setting
rows.definition: Enables expert page-cache adoption for documented truthy values; unset and other values keep the historical read path.
rows.distinction: PageCacheEnabled reports a source's active mapped read path; this setting controls the loader opt-in.

rows.definition: Arms the context control engine and gate and returns its tool definitions.
rows.distinction: ContextControlCatalog reads tool definitions when armed; arming installs the control.

rows.definition: Arms the gateway readiness policy until host-owned backend warmup completes; nil server is safe.
rows.distinction: API host probe readiness gate summarizes endpoint classifications; this method arms serving warmup readiness.

rows.definition: Looks up an active copy-on-write session branch by ID and returns an error when absent.
rows.distinction: COW page-table child fork creates a branch; this method retrieves one by ID.

rows.definition: Extracts a bearer authorization token or an X-Api-Key from an HTTP request.
rows.distinction: Guard router upstream stores resolved outgoing router credentials; this helper reads incoming request credentials.

rows.definition: Reports whether a session ID is registered in the copy-on-write page table.
rows.distinction: COW page-table session lookup returns the branch or an error; this method returns only presence.

rows.definition: Creates a copy-on-write session branch through the CreateSession operation.
rows.distinction: COW page-table session lookup retrieves an existing branch; registration creates one.

rows.definition: Buffers streaming content to keep text-form tool calls from reaching the client as ordinary text before structured-call handling.
rows.distinction: Gateway warmup readiness arming controls readiness; the lift guard protects the live stream content boundary.

rows.canonical: Session cost ring latest context tokens
rows.definition: Returns the latest recorded context-token observation, or zero when the cost ring has no history.
rows.distinction: ContextSafetyVerdict is a stream safety assessment; this method reads one recent session observation.

rows.definition: Stores session-owned Gemma 4 cached continuation identity, attention rows, options, and lifecycle state.
rows.distinction: In-kernel generation result is a completed request result; this state persists cached continuation within a model session.

rows.definition: Implements a model session's resident-weight matrix operations and admits each host matmul stage through session execution policy.
rows.distinction: Native forward session-step is a trace kind; sessionResidentKernel performs host resident-weight operations.

rows.definition: Names the session_step forward timing kind used for serial native decode tracing.
rows.distinction: Session-owned resident host kernel executes model operations; this value classifies a forward timing event.

rows.definition: Updates an open Metal MTP coordinator target under locks, closing an owned draft session and resetting draft and verification state.
rows.distinction: sessionFromPrefixClone constructs a model session around a cache; this setter changes a coordinator's target.

rows.definition: Opens and loads a streamed-dense Q4K model with cooperative context cancellation, transferring checkpoint lifetime to the returned model.
rows.distinction: The precision-aware KV cache constructor creates empty attention cache state; this loader constructs a model from checkpoint weights.

rows.canonical: V4.1 Engram row cache replacement policy
rows.definition: Selects LRU or explicit CLOCK replacement for the bounded Engram row cache.
rows.distinction: Engram row cache options specify geometry, budget, prefetch and policy; this type names replacement choices.

rows.definition: Configures Engram row cache geometry, resident budget, prefetch and replacement policy.
rows.distinction: Engram cache policy selects a replacement strategy; these options configure the whole row cache.

rows.definition: Returns a retained f32 block by name and refreshes its recency on a hit.
rows.distinction: Layer cache reset clears retained state; lookup reads a named block and updates recency.

rows.definition: Clears retained layer expert blocks, eviction ordering, and byte accounting from projection scratch.
rows.distinction: Layer cache lookup returns and touches a block; reset clears the scratch cache.

rows.definition: Returns the bounded f32 layer expert cache budget when a checkpoint tier exists, otherwise zero.
rows.distinction: Layer cache lookup obtains retained data; this method selects the cache byte budget.

rows.definition: Tracks whether gateway backend warmup is armed and complete so readiness can reflect the boot transition.
rows.distinction: ArmWarmupGate arms this readiness policy; warmupGate stores the state.

rows.definition: Configures per-turn durable checkpoint writes under a directory using a session ID.
rows.distinction: LoadSessionCheckpoint reads saved checkpoint data; this run option configures writing.

rows.definition: Binds the turnkey workspace tenant as the prefix-cache identity on a request context, using a background context when nil.
rows.distinction: WithPrefixCacheIdentity is the general owner-binding helper; turnkeyRequestContext supplies the turnkey workspace identity.

rows.canonical: Llama cache observer slots endpoint override
rows.definition: Overrides the derived llama-server slots telemetry URL for a proxy or bridge with a non-default endpoint.
rows.distinction: The Llama soft-slot setting enables conversation slot selection; SlotsURL directs an observer to a telemetry endpoint.

rows.definition: Validates the source, geometry, and budget and creates a bounded Engram row cache.
rows.distinction: Engram row cache options describe construction inputs; this function validates and constructs the cache.

rows.definition: Reports whether fail-closed teardown retired a model session.
rows.distinction: COW invalid session ID error signals an invalid branch-operation ID; this predicate reports backend session teardown state.

rows.definition: Runs a speculative verification round and preserves the legacy immediate commit of its accepted prefix.
rows.distinction: ParallelVerifyKernelOwned returns a provisional round for a later Finish or Abort; ParallelVerifyKernel immediately commits the accepted prefix.

rows.definition: Returns the configured engine label, custom for an injected driver, mock for explicit mock mode, or unconfigured when no real engine exists.
rows.distinction: Guard router upstream stores an outgoing connection target; this method labels the all-in-one engine configuration for topology reporting.

rows.definition: Clears the session's prefix lookup and closes it through an injected closer when present, otherwise through Session.Close.
rows.distinction: BackendSessionClosed reports whether fail-closed teardown has retired a session; closeLaneSession performs scheduler cleanup.

rows.definition: Is the sentinel for fail-closed cached-continuation selection, state, or lifetime refusal.
rows.distinction: Gemma 4 cached continuation state stores the session's continuation; this sentinel identifies a refusal.

rows.definition: Applies one Engram layer to resident streams by decoding gathered rows, projecting, and publishing gate/add output; it may decline before device work.
rows.distinction: V41EngramGateStreams specifies the fixed stream count; this function performs the layer operation.

rows.definition: Defines the fixed hyper-connection stream count read by the Engram gate from its resident panel.
rows.distinction: The device Engram gate function applies a layer; this constant specifies its stream geometry.

rows.definition: Defines the backend operation that splits a combined Qwen 3.5 query-gate tensor into query and gate tensors.
rows.distinction: splitPackedQueryGate is the host splitter for packed query and output-gate vectors; this interface exposes a backend tensor split operation.

rows.definition: Supplies the guard adjudication posture as an environment setting when resolving guard configuration.
rows.distinction: Native agent receipt guard posture records the effective value; this environment setting is a configuration input.

rows.definition: Prefixes MCP-exposed Fak guard tool names and is stripped by agent tool normalization.
rows.distinction: The prefixed capabilities tool name identifies a particular tool; this prefix is shared across guard tools.

rows.canonical: Fak guard MCP capabilities tool name
rows.definition: Names the prefixed capabilities tool accepted by gateway capability-tool recognition.
rows.distinction: The Fak guard MCP prefix is shared by multiple tools; this full name identifies capabilities.

rows.definition: Computes scaled dot-product causal attention for prompt-panel queries against cached keys and values.
rows.distinction: Qwen causal panel geometry validation checks dimensions and ABI bounds; this function computes attention output.

rows.canonical: Qwen causal attention panel geometry validation
rows.definition: Validates Qwen causal attention panel KV and query-head geometry and checks CUDA integer ABI bounds.
rows.distinction: Batched prefill causal attention computes the contraction; this validator checks panel geometry before an operation.

rows.definition: Resolves and validates compressed-stream selection rows and normalizes them to the published per-position top-k stride.
rows.distinction: Selected V4.1 shared attention invokes a selected attention operation; the index list resolves its selection indices.

rows.definition: Invokes the selected shared attention function and wraps its failure with layer and attention-stage context.
rows.distinction: V4.1 attention index list resolves selection indices; this helper invokes the selected attention implementation.

rows.definition: Controls retention of eligible native quantized linear-attention rows after raw reorder; false forces the historical Q8 route.
rows.distinction: Cancellable streamed Q4K model loader loads weights; this option selects eligible linear-attention row handling.

rows.definition: Validates attention geometry and constructs empty V4.1 temporal attention state with a bounded compression ratio.
rows.distinction: V4.1 attention index list resolves compressed selections from state; this constructor allocates and initializes the state.

rows.definition: Groups graph results for attention output and the raw key, post-rotation key, and value panels.
rows.distinction: Batched prefill causal attention computes a host contraction; this structure carries graph-owned output panels.

rows.definition: Validates shared-attention mode, geometry, scale, tensor sizes and ABI bounds before execution and computes byte sizes.
rows.distinction: Selected V4.1 shared attention invocation calls the chosen operation; this validator checks its inputs.

rows.canonical: Metal Qwen graph attention with host F32 prefix
rows.definition: Native graph entrypoint for ordered-panel Qwen attention using host F32 key and value prefix inputs.
rows.distinction: The device-KV entrypoint reads a persistent device prefix; this entrypoint takes host prefix pointers.

rows.canonical: Metal Qwen graph attention with device F32 KV
rows.definition: Native graph entrypoint for ordered-panel Qwen attention against persistent device F32 key and value storage.
rows.distinction: The host-prefix entrypoint takes host key and value prefix pointers; this entrypoint uses device KV storage.

rows.canonical: Metal Qwen graph attention with host Q8 prefix
rows.definition: Native graph entrypoint for Qwen panel attention using a packed Q8 host KV prefix and producing packed panel rows.
rows.distinction: The device-Q8 entrypoint attends over a persistent device store; this entrypoint takes the host packed prefix.

rows.canonical: Metal Qwen graph attention with device Q8 KV
rows.definition: Native graph entrypoint for Qwen panel attention that appends and reads packed Q8 KV in a persistent device store.
rows.distinction: The host-Q8 entrypoint receives packed host prefix rows; this entrypoint reads and appends device KV.

rows.canonical: V4 Flash ratio-zero per-head attention sink weights
rows.definition: Stores one learnable sink value per head for the ratio-zero reference attention reduction; the sink contributes to the softmax denominator without a value.
rows.distinction: v41SparseAttentionSinkChecked obtains and validates a sink for a selected layer; AttnSink is the ratio-zero reference weight vector.

rows.definition: Dispatches attention with an arbitrary topologically ordered causal tree mask for up to 32 speculative queries to a capable tensor or default backend.
rows.distinction: Batched prefill causal attention follows sequential prompt causality; tree verification accepts an explicit branch-tree mask.

rows.definition: Aggregates per-layer V4.1 attention descriptor incompatibilities against the native forward admission contract.
rows.distinction: V4.1 shared attention input validation checks invocation tensor geometry; this preflight examines checkpoint descriptors across layers.

rows.definition: Selects the candidate CUDA shared-attention Go binding when combined with cuda and cgo build tags.
rows.distinction: V4.1 shared attention input validation checks runtime operands; this build tag selects compilation of the CUDA binding.

rows.definition: Carries execution-time capability-floor posture, profile and safe-sink configuration.
rows.distinction: PolicyFromContext extracts this value from a context; PolicyContext is the carried data.

rows.definition: Extracts a PolicyContext from a Go context when present and reports whether it was found.
rows.distinction: PolicyContext is the execution-time data; PolicyFromContext retrieves it.

rows.definition: Returns a derived context carrying the requested structured-compression policy, using a background context if nil.
rows.distinction: WithCompressionContext supplies a context to compression options; WithCompressionPolicy binds a policy into a context.

rows.definition: Builds and adjudicates a tool call with an optional sequence number, handles transformations and lease admission, and records the operation.
rows.distinction: ABI policy context extraction reads execution policy data; this method adjudicates a gateway tool call.

rows.definition: Sets the posture that agent Configure uses to initialize the adjudicator policy.
rows.distinction: PostureDefaultOpen is one ABI posture value; this setter changes the configured agent posture.

rows.definition: Selects the ABI posture that permits tools by default after provable refusal checks pass.
rows.distinction: Agent configured posture setter changes a configured posture; PostureDefaultOpen is one possible ABI value.

rows.definition: Stores the configured soft-slot policy and passes it to the HTTP planner for request slot selection.
rows.distinction: HTTP planner LlamaSoftSlotPolicy is the consumer field; this gateway field carries its configured value.

rows.definition: Carries the wire adjudication verdict within a gateway feature-proof record.
rows.distinction: Gateway sequenced tool adjudication computes a verdict; this field records one in a proof.

rows.definition: Names the verdict metadata posture value stamped when an operator approval admits a call.
rows.distinction: ABI default-open posture is a policy default; this marker records a specific operator-approved admission.

rows.definition: Marks a kernel policy block in intra-model routing input.
rows.distinction: PolicyReason carries the refusal reason; PolicyRefusal is the boolean block signal.

rows.definition: Carries the policy refusal reason in intra-model routing input.
rows.distinction: PolicyRefusal signals that a policy block occurred; PolicyReason carries its reason.

rows.definition: Names the attention query B projection weight in GGUF tensor mappings, including the per-head query up-projection.
rows.distinction: The attention output projection maps attention results onward; the query B weight expands the query path into heads.

rows.definition: Names the attention output projection tensor in GGUF mappings.
rows.distinction: The attention query B projection expands the query path; the output projection acts after attention.

rows.canonical: GGUF attention key normalization weight name
rows.definition: Names the attention key-normalization weight in GGUF transform contracts.
rows.distinction: Attention output projection maps attention results onward; the key-normalization weight acts on the key path.

rows.definition: Signals that a requested Q4K loader route lacks a qualified transformed-weight estimate; malformed inputs to supported routes use other errors.
rows.distinction: The cancellable streamed Q4K loader loads a model; this sentinel reports that a separate transformed-weight estimate is unqualified.

rows.definition: Carries whether the session runs a Metal forward and, for a genuine Metal miss, its skip reason.
rows.distinction: ResolveServeMetalDecision computes this result from serve selection and probes; serveMetalDecision carries the result.

rows.definition: Resolves serve Metal selection and reports a Metal miss reason only when Metal was actually targeted.
rows.distinction: serveMetalDecision is the result value; this function computes it.

rows.definition: Determines whether the GGUF serve path uses streamed CPU-offload experts and returns the corresponding resident bound.
rows.distinction: Serve Metal availability resolver decides Metal targeting; this decision concerns the streamed CPU-offload path and resident bound.

rows.canonical: In-kernel DeepSeek V4.1 chat segment renderer
rows.definition: Builds the V4.1 chat branch as trusted template segments and ordinary client segments after applying tool choice.
rows.distinction: Template render failure message reports an upstream refusal; this function renders the in-kernel V4.1 chat request.

rows.definition: Names the OpenAI-style error code upstream_template_render for an upstream chat-template rendering failure.
rows.distinction: Template render message supplies scrubbed client-facing detail; this constant supplies the branchable code.

rows.definition: Builds a bounded client message from a fixed prefix and a scrubbed upstream error message.
rows.distinction: The upstream template-render error code supplies a branchable identifier; this function constructs the client message.

rows.definition: Checks that all required Qwen 3.5 MTP head tensors were materialized when a seen set is supplied.
rows.distinction: Cancellable streamed Q4K model loader loads checkpoint weights; this validator checks a required retained MTP tensor set.

rows.definition: Maintains bounded FIFO detail rows while accumulating monotonic session summary counters.
rows.distinction: Gateway sessionView snapshots terminal transcript and effects; this view retains lifecycle detail and summary.

rows.definition: Reports whether text contains a recognized surrender or give-up phrase.
rows.distinction: StopGate evaluates completion evidence at a final boundary; IsSurrenderNote only recognizes a surrender phrase in text.

rows.definition: Memoizes eligible search operations across unchanged directory trees and invalidates results hierarchically by path scope.
rows.distinction: Radix startup-claim cache coordinates model prefix claims; SearchCache retains tool search results and invalidates them on filesystem mutation.

rows.definition: Holds an optional post-condition callback checked before a model final answer may end the owned loop.
rows.distinction: IsSurrenderNote detects a textual surrender phrase; finalGate checks an explicit completion post-condition.

rows.definition: Collects a process-ID set for session-index classification and reports failure when the process table is unreadable.
rows.distinction: Session durability host label identifies the local host; this function snapshots currently observed process IDs.

rows.definition: Defines acquire, release, availability and capacity operations for worker instances by role.
rows.distinction: L3 dispatcher proxy pool reuses network clients; WorkerPool allocates worker dispatchers by role.

rows.definition: Maps remote addresses to reusable proxy clients under a mutex, closing and removing failed connections.
rows.distinction: Harness WorkerPool allocates worker instances; proxyPool retains network clients by address.

rows.canonical: L3 protocol message body pool index
rows.definition: Records the owning body-buffer pool index on a message, or minus one for an unpooled body, so the buffer can be returned.
rows.distinction: L3 dispatcher proxy pool holds reusable clients; BodyPoolIdx identifies a message buffer pool.

rows.definition: Signals that an observer pool has been stopped when an operation requires an active pool.
rows.distinction: Harness WorkerPool is an allocation interface; ErrPoolStopped is an observer lifecycle error.

rows.canonical: Info command gateway URL environment default
rows.definition: Supplies the default gateway URL for the fak info polling flag, falling back to the local gateway URL.
rows.distinction: Llama observer SlotsURL targets slots telemetry; FAK_GATEWAY_URL supplies the info command gateway default.

rows.definition: Stores the number of staging slots in a Vulkan staging pool, which requires at least two at construction.
rows.distinction: Vulkan staging pool slot size is bytes per slot; numSlots counts slots.

rows.definition: Stores the byte capacity of each slot in a Vulkan staging pool.
rows.distinction: Vulkan staging pool slot count is the number of slots; slotSize is each slot's byte capacity.
